name: net_hashes_agree_long_match
description: Four clients over links of 1 to 4 turns with jitter play a whole High Water match (hollow12) to its end: two Lamplighters and two Lookouts, each seat played by its plan bot through the turns. Every client flags the same checkpoint ticks and keeps its last two; the sequencer asks for them in rotation and keeps every one it is sent, each with the agreed hash as its digest. Every hash any client sends agrees with the others', all four run every wave to the last, their agreed RESULT ends the match, and all four stop at the same final tick in the same state.

steps.assert: scene.client(4).seat == 4 and scene.client(1).sim.seats.size() == 4 and scene.client(2).sim.seat(2).builder == 'lookout' and scene.client(1).sim.total_waves() == 12
steps.msg: four seats, two Lamplighters and two Lookouts, on hollow12's twelve waves
the match ran to its end, decided by the agreed RESULT, with no hash apart
the hollow went through every wave, or the Holdfast fell
all four were told the same outcome and stopped at the agreed final tick, in the same state
the four hash streams, hundreds of ticks long, are equal tick for tick

steps.assert: scene.seq.uploads_kept.size() >= 12 and scene.seq.uploads_dropped.is_empty() and scene.kept_digests_agree() and scene.flagged_ticks_ok()
steps.msg: every checkpoint asked for was kept, each with the agreed hash as its digest, at the contract's ticks
asked in rotation, every seat uploaded
each kept its last two checkpoints and none needed a resync
